summary: Verified HiTechBot-style Trailing Take Profit + Trailing DCA (bottom chase) implementation. Wrote 9 new pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_trailing_bot_logic.py that directly exercise server._bot_tick with mocked fetch_price / _execute_trade to drive price series through the trough & peak tracking logic; all 9 pass. Existing test_trading_verification.py (9 tests) still fully green. Frontend /pair/BTCUSDT rendered under mobile viewport, admin logged in: Operation Reminder panel renders, trigger-state chip reads 'Waiting for trigger' (BTC bot currently waiting), locked-profit-meter / bottom-tracker / dca-recover-row are conditionally hidden as expected, MC trigger row description now reads 'Arms bottom-tracker when price ≤ trigger', TP row still shows 'Arms peak-tracker · 1.5% profit', 6-tab bottom nav (home/market/trade/wallet/bot/profile), DCA ladder still renders 10 levels. No console errors related to trailing logic (only harmless Binance WebSocket 451 geo-restriction errors, pre-existing). Backend logs show engine still polling Binance & creating trades; no new exceptions from trailing logic.

minor.issue: Response does NOT explicitly include the key `dca_bottom_price` when the bot doc has never armed it. `merged.get('dca_bottom_price')` yields None instead of 0. Requirement explicitly says: 'returns the new trailing fields ... dca_bottom_price ... (numbers/booleans, not undefined)'. Fix: add `merged['dca_bottom_price'] = round(trough, 6)` near line 645 alongside peak_price / dca_recover_trigger_price.

action_items: MINOR: Explicitly expose `dca_bottom_price` in GET /api/bots/{symbol} response merged dict (currently missing when the field has never been armed on the bot doc). Suggested one-line fix in server.py get_bot(): merged['dca_bottom_price'] = round(trough, 6) if trough else 0.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1681 lines — well over the 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting into modules (bots.py, trades.py, market.py, auth.py, engine.py). Not blocking.
server.py still uses deprecated `@app.on_event(...)` handlers (2 warnings) — switch to lifespan handler.

In _bot_tick TP branch, when the peak already equals the current price the DB write is skipped (`if new_peak != peak`). Fine for peak_price, but note that the FIRST time price >= tp_trigger with peak==0, new_peak = max(0, price) = price so the write DOES fire — good.
Trailing DCA correctly resets dca_bottom_price to 0 after a safety-order buy AND on every SELL/first-buy (server.py lines 963-964, 988-989, 1038-1039, 1070-1071, 1213) — verified via tests.
Race condition risk: _bot_tick reads bot dict (in-memory), then updates DB. If two ticks overlap (unlikely with 10s cadence) trough writes could stomp. Acceptable for MVP.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/pytest.ini (new; enables asyncio_mode=auto with session loop scope)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids resolve, trigger chip label correct, conditional panels hidden as spec'd)

seed_data_creation: Test bot doc for symbol TESTBTCUSDT is inserted/mutated/cleaned within each test class. status='stopped' so the real bot_engine_loop ignores it. Cleanup by symbol removes leftovers from prior runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The trailing-bot pytest expects pytest-asyncio (installed via pip). /app/backend/tests/pytest.ini sets asyncio_mode=auto and pins BOTH default fixture AND default test loop scope to 'session' — this is REQUIRED because motor's AsyncIOMotorClient binds to the event loop at import time; per-test loops trigger 'Event loop is closed' errors. To rerun: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v
rca of the issue: Only minor gap: DEFAULT_BOT_CFG doesn't include dca_bottom_price, and get_bot() reads trough via merged.get('dca_bottom_price', 0) but never writes it back into merged before returning, so the field is absent for bots that never armed a DCA trough. Fix in one line as noted above.
